policy: Per-document reading of whole, source-matched TRAIN abstracts before candidate predictions; preserve literal Unicode spans, include explicit method families, exclude physical research objects, disciplines and unnamed corpora. Longest same-class mentions only; unresolved document or coordinated head quarantined rather than all-O. All relations remain UNRESOLVED pending separate evidence review. Same-session AI pseudo labels, not independent gold.
